sources: recreation.gov search (no North Shore campground listed on the Kootenai NF), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 16 sites including one host site (15 public), 3 of them pull-through; paved roads and parking spurs, RVs up to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-shore-campground ('The campground has 16 sites (3 pull throughs) including one host site, with tables and fire rings and able to accommodate up to a 40' RV. Campground roads and campsite parking spurs are paved.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Campground host; boat launch with dock and boat parking (open all year, weather permitting). The page says both 'potable water' (amenities) and 'Potable water is not available at this site.'

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-shore-campground ('Amenities include a campground host, potable water, vault toilets and a fully developed boat launch with dock and boat parking'; Water 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day. Campground gate is closed from December 1 to May 1, but may close earlier if we get a large amount of snow.'

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-shore-campground ('Single Site: $16 per night', '$16.00 daily fee per single site'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/north-shore-campground ('50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF campground on Noxon Reservoir (Clark Fork River), ~4 mi N of Trout Creek off Hwy 200 via North Shore Rd. Boat launch with dock; six day-use picnic sites (two covered) by the ramp. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 40-ft RV max, 3 pull-throughs, vault toilets, $16/night, senior/access pass 50% discount, phone. Changed count 16 -> 15 (the 16th is the host site). Added season (gate open May 1 - Nov 30, managed Memorial Day - Labor Day). Left potable water alone (page contradicts itself). Not stated: hookups, reservations/FCFS. Note trimmed of restated values.
